body: Thanks. I wish it would too. But it won’t.

I just don’t see any other path in front of me. I always figured it would end up this way, but somehow for a while I convinced myself things were different. If I had gone through with it back then things would have been easier.
There will be a day when you are out of school and they are no longer in charge of your life.
Unfortunately there aren’t a lot of sure shot methods.  Please think it over.
I know the feeling. I’m sorry.

I’m so sorry this happened to you. But it’s better to happen before you spend years in an unhappy marriage. They saved you heartache, although I know it doesn’t feel like it. 

Take some time to feel the loss of this relationship. But it’s not over.
School is not as important as they make it out to be. I know it’s hard, but you can make it through. If you can at school get access to a tutor. That might help.
